name: Triptych Music Video Data
description: Finds every song's official music video ahead of time (a 30-second HD preview from Apple Music) for Triptych's Now Playing. Adds an Apple Music Video ID to songs, editable in Edit Metadata. Only links are stored; videos stream from Apple.
overview: Music videos for Triptych's Now Playing

versions.changelog: Apple's Japanese store for Japanese titles and J-pop/anime artists; your own country's store first (Slovak artists have more videos in SK/CZ), then US; every part of a title counts ("うっせぇわ - Usseewa", "강남스타일 (Gangnam Style)"). Songs without a video are looked at again.
First version: finds each song's music video (Apple Music preview) for Triptych 2.6.0.
